name: SikaRoof Anchor-W PVC
paste:
SIKAROOF® ANCHOR-W PVC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC, April 2023, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sikaroof_anchor-wpvc.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC is a manufactured preformed accessory providing a secure watertight connection directly between the roof substructure/roof deck and waterproofing membrane.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Universal connection point for fixing roof mounted products to exposed Sarnafil® PVC and Sikaplan® PVC roofing membranes.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Prefabricated universal roof connection point
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Provides a secure watertight anchor to the roof deck
    - Resistant to UV radiation
    - Heat weldable
    - Adaptable for different substrates and mounting requirements
    - Removes the wind load off of the membrane and onto the structural deck
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Injected, modified polyvinyl chloride (PVC) compound / Machined Stainless Steel Grade 316. Washer made of galvanized carbon steel.
2.5 Appearance and colour.
    | White and light grey | Stainless Steel |
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Width: 180 mm ø (+/- 3)
    - Height: 50 mm (+/- 1)
2.7 System structure. SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC is compatible with all types of exposed Sarnafil® PVC and Sikaplan® PVC membranes.
    | Fixing substrate | Concrete, metal deck, Plywood/OSB |
    | Thermal insulation requirement | The compressive strength must be |
    | sufficient to carry the additional long term load of the connection point. |
    | Roof slope | Maximum 10° |
    | Design load | Maximum 1600 N per SikaRoof® An- |
    | chor-W PVC fixed with 4 fasteners (allowable vertical uplift capacity) |
    | Fastener | Design load according to fastener |
    | supplier. Sika recommends Sarnafast fastener type SBF-6.0 |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
    Maximum 800 N per SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC fixed with 2 fasteners (allowable vertical uplift capacity). Fasteners must be arranged diagonally on the SSikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC washer plate.
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Pre-assembled unit (PVC part is already assembled/sealed to the washer). Fasteners are not included. Sika recommends Sarnafast Fastener type SBF- 6.0. Also refer to price list.
    - Shelf life: 5 years from date of production.
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Installation procedure
    - Clean Sarnafil® PVC or Sikaplan® PVC membrane around installation area.
    - Fix the SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC to the substrate with appropriate fasteners and weld the edge of the SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC PVC base plate to the waterproofing membrane. Use electric hot air welding equipment such as manual hot air welding guns (Leister) and pressure rollers in accordance with current Sika® application manuals.
    - Sufficient roof drainage characteristics after installing SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC needs to be ensured.
    - The suitability of an M12 threaded steel section must be checked to prevent the risk of bimetallic corrosion.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations. Installation work must only be carried out by Sika® trained and approved contractors, experienced in this type of application.
    - Sika® is not responsible for the permissible SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC forces or the related loading calculations.
    - Preliminary pull-out tests are mandatory.
    - Installation of ancillary products, e.g. contact adhesives / cleaners is limited to temperatures above +5 °C. Refer to relevant Product Data Sheets for further information.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. -20 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. -30 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - Installation of ancillary products, e.g. contact adhesives / cleaners is limited to temperatures above +5 °C. Refer to relevant Product Data Sheets for further information.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® Anchor-W PVC, April 2023, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sikaroof_anchor-wpvc.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
